engine: AIR T-310 act-divider, round v3 (v2 amplitude + sticky escort): 2-4 words of an act headline start as a GATHERED word-sentence near the row center (almost touching, wordGapEm 0.14) and spread to the FULL row width (first word flush left, last flush right; flex space-between = the CSS truth). Progress = the REAL pass of the divider section through the viewport (C21): the atom resolves a pass section ([data-srh-section] or opt.section, ~200vh) and scrubs it 'top top' -> 'bottom bottom', i.e. p=(-rect.top)/(rect.height-vh). V3: the row (with its kicker) lives in a CSS sticky wrapper (top:0, height:100vh, grid-centered) so it holds the viewport center for the ENTIRE 2-viewport pass - the words escort the whole act, zero empty color bands (C22 emptiness, the v2 defect). NO GSAP pin: sticky only, owns_pin stays false, the pin budget is untouched. transform translateX ONLY, split by WORDS (D12), fonts.ready before measuring. T-M01 mobile (<=768px): the spread dies; the atom collapses into a LEFT 2-line wrap by SEMANTIC pair ([data-srh-group]), static, no pin (C7).

measured_teardown.move: words spread across the whole row while a CSS sticky wrapper (100vh, host markup - not the atom, not a pin) holds the row at the viewport center for the entire section pass. apply(p) is a PURE progress function: each word owns a staggered progress sub-window; the house ease lives INSIDE the sub-window while the track stays 1:1 with the scrollbar (R_timing_layers). The gathered phrase at p=0 sits at convergeAnchor with natural word widths + tight wordGapEm gaps and reads as ONE compact word-sentence; at p=1 the spread spans >=90% of the viewport width (C27 act-event scale). Measured at 1440x900: spread bbox 699 -> 1111 -> 1328 -> 1374 -> 1382px across p=[0/.25/.5/.75/1], delta 684px = 47.5% vw, first word travels 342px, full word bboxes inside the viewport at all 5 positions, dead-band scan (300px step) = 0 bands.
measured_teardown.cited: AIR act-dividers, 8+ uses site-wide: THE MOMENTUM / TO RISE HIGHER, A NEW PREMIUM FORMAT, AT THE CENTER OF LIFE, DISTRICT VIEWS, TRANSPORT ACCESSIBILITY, KEY ADVANTAGES, SIMILAR OFFICES, INVESTMENT STRATEGIES. Mobile: the spread is LOST -> left 2-line semantic wrap; act separation passes to bg inversion (T-M07). Physics note: long words eat amplitude - an act headline wants SHORT words (12-14 letters total for 3 words) so the gathered cluster stays <=55% of the row and the spread delta clears 40% vw.

section.what: the pass element (selector or element) whose trip through the viewport drives progress (C21). Default resolution: host.closest('[data-srh-section]'). When found, the scrub window is its full internal pass ('top top' -> 'bottom bottom'); give it ~200vh and put the row inside a sticky 100vh grid-centered wrapper so the words escort the whole pass (v3 law: no empty color bands; sticky, never GSAP pin; sticky ancestors free of overflow-x:hidden per K1.7). No section -> fallback: the row's own pass ('top bottom' -> 'top 25%').

spreadWidth.what: how much of the full edge-to-edge spread the settled state uses. 1 = first word flush left, last flush right (AIR canon); 0.8 = spread held 80% of the way toward the edges.

convergeAnchor.what: where the gathered phrase sits at p=0: 0 = flush left, 0.5 = centered cluster, 1 = flush right.

stagger.what: per-word progress-window offset so the row does not travel as one rigid block; the left word leads, each next word trails by this slice (clamped so all windows fit in 0..1).

wordGapEm.what: inter-word gap of the gathered phrase. Tight by design (almost touching): the converged cluster must read as ONE compact word-sentence, which is what buys the spread its amplitude. Measured from the host font-size once in measure(), never per frame.

ease.what: named house token ('air' = cubic-bezier(.25,.74,.22,.99), 'out-quad', 'out-expo', 'linear') applied INSIDE each word's progress sub-window; the track itself follows the scrollbar 1:1. Inlined bezier solver (D13: no gsap.utils.parseEase).

direction.what: 'spread' = gathered -> full spread as the divider passes through (settled state = the AIR spread signature); 'converge' = the inverse read (spread -> gathered).

start.what: explicit ScrollTrigger start override. Unset = C21 defaults: 'top top' on the pass section, or 'top bottom' on the row itself when no section resolves.

end.what: explicit ScrollTrigger end override. Unset = C21 defaults: 'bottom bottom' on the pass section, or 'top 25%' on the row itself.

trigger.what: 'scroll' = ScrollTrigger scrub drives apply(p); 'progress' = no trigger, the integrator drives set(p) manually.

mode.what: 'auto' = matchMedia picks the branch and rebuilds on breakpoint crossing; 'desktop' / 'mobile' force a branch (the lab forces 'mobile' inside a 360px box to probe the T-M01 collapse).

mobileBreakpoint.what: max-width at/below which the T-M01 left semantic stack replaces the spread.

manageLenis.what: own a guarded Lenis instance (true) or let the page drive a shared one (false, default).

entry: SpreadRowHeadline.create(target, opts) -> { words, lines, groups, mode, trigger, set(p), measure(), refresh(), destroy(), ready }. target = a headline element; semantic pairs declared as <span data-srh-group> children (no groups = whole text is one group). ready = a Promise resolving after fonts.ready + wiring (the lab awaits it before probing). set(p 0..1) is PURE and reversible.
law: transform translateX(px) ONLY on .srh-word; zero CSS transition on scroll-driven props (D3); split by WORDS never letters (D12); fonts.ready before split-measure; geometry read in measure()/onRefresh only, never in the frame (no getComputedStyle per tick, D6); no mix-blend / no backdrop-filter / no WebGL; owns_pin false and the mobile branch never pins (C7) - the row is held at the viewport center by a HOST-side CSS sticky wrapper (100vh = innerHeight per B14), never a GSAP pin and never a translateY, and every sticky ancestor must be free of overflow-x:hidden (K1.7: clip only); the component NEVER sets __LAB_OK__ - the lab owns the gate with geo-probes (B14/B15).
gate_mode: scroll-scrub over the section pass (default). Verify in the lab: AMPLITUDE machine check - the spread bbox delta (last.right - first.left) between p=0 and p=1 EXCEEDS 40% of the viewport width on BOTH acts, and the first word travels >=15% vw; at p=1 the first word locks to the row's left edge and the last to the right edge (+-3px) with the row >=90% vw wide (C27); at p=0 the cluster <=55% of the row, every inter-word gap tight, cluster centered (+-10%); at all 5 track positions [0/.25/.5/.75/1] the FULL bbox of every word sits inside the viewport (the sticky wrapper keeps the row framed the whole track); word order preserved with zero neighbour overlap; DEAD-BAND SCAN - walk the whole page in 300px steps and wherever an act section covers >60% of the viewport the word row MUST intersect the 60..(vh-60) zone, zero bands allowed, plus the sticky ancestor chain checked for overflow-x:hidden (K1.7); the 360px forced-mobile box renders exactly 2 left-aligned static lines split by the semantic pair. MOBILE-viewport gate (<=768px, e.g. 390x844): the page swaps to the M1-M7 probe pack - both acts rebuilt into the T-M01 branch, page height <= 7 screens (short sections, no desktop runway), no content gap > 1.5 screens, every text Range-rect at bbox.left >= 16px, acts vertically centered in their sections (+-15%), and the stack lines EXACTLY equal the explicit [data-srh-group] pairs (semantic break lives in the markup, never mechanical auto-wrap).
proven: lab.html (fix round v3): the divider does its REAL job - it stands BETWEEN full-bleed render sections (C11, renders/ symlink to the house proto set) over the light/dark theme rhythm. Two Ukrainian acts with short act-words (ЧАС РОСТИ ВИЩЕ; НОВИЙ ТИП ДОМУ) in 200vh pass sections with sticky-escorted rows + a 360px forced-mobile box (У ЦЕНТРІ / ЖИТТЯ) + a small tail marker (no dead-empty tail screen). Headless-measured at 1440x900: act1 spread 699/1111/1328/1374/1382px at p=[0/.25/.5/.75/1] (delta 47.5% vw), act2 728/1088/1327/1374/1382px (delta 45.5% vw), full word bboxes in-viewport at all 5 positions; dead-band scan step 300px: 21 positions, 12 act-covered checks, 0 bands (v2 had 8 at y=600/900/1800/2100/3300/3600/4500/4800), sticky ancestor chain clean; both acts also pass at 1280x720 (scan 0 bands). Mobile pack at 390x844: page 4.15 screens, max content gap 0.22 screens, min text-rect left 23.4px, acts centered, semantic wrap exact (Час рости/вище; Новий/тип дому). __LAB_OK__ requires all geo-probes incl. the amplitude anti-regression and the dead-band scan plus zero console errors.
